title: Verify: .gitignore holds depth-independent node_modules/ rule unit tests
description: Test reads the real .gitignore and asserts the rule lines.
acceptance_criteria: Given the real .gitignore, then lines include node_modules/
Given the real .gitignore, then lines exclude game/node_modules/

steps.action: Add a test that reads ../../../.gitignore via readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new NodeURL('../../../.gitignore', import.meta.url)),'utf8'), splits lines, and asserts toContain('node_modules/') and not.toContain('game/node_modules/').
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gitignoreRule.test.ts
